screening.matching: Listed article byline exact account matches are strict authors. Explicit is_primary publication metadata supplies a separate primary-account category. Other publication bylines are reported separately, not automatically attributed to this article. Account identity establishes an account match, not sole human authorship.
screening.response_definition: Nondeleted nonempty saved nonself descendant within seven days. Direct is one edge, indirect at least two. Any author deeper in a branch may address an intervening comment, not the focal claim. Missing and immature capture are flagged.
screening.baseline_design: Up to twenty mature 5–800 word unmatched-reader comments per publication, on public prose >=150 words, chosen by seeded min-hash without using regex, replies or reactions. Equal-publication sample, not a simple random sample of all comments.
screening.enrichment_design: Top thirty text scores per publication, regardless of replies, plus all eligible regex candidates with matched author participation; arms can overlap and must stay separate from baseline. Outcome-enriched arm cannot estimate prevalence or an unconditional response effect.

prior_loyalty_calibration.note: Calibration on already reviewed cases, not independent recall validation. V1 narrow regex retrieved 10/19; v2 broadened with political critique.

model_comparison.protocol: Same 127 cases, complete saved article and immediate parent, frozen prompt and JSON schema, up to five focals per request, temperature .7, top_p .8, top_k 20, seed 42619, thinking disabled, context 16384. Initial runtime .24; three models rechecked on .40.6 to separate runtime from model effects. No prompt tuned after predictions.
model_comparison.reference: One assistant manual review, not independently adjudicated human truth. Enriched diagnostic set includes 81 article-stratified baseline cases and additional difficult cases. Prior-positive sensitivity cases do not establish specificity. Not platform-wide performance.
model_comparison.runtime: Temporary workspace copy, cloud disabled, loopback only. Existing Ollama install and paid-job stop flags unchanged.
